test_title: PYST 69: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A student got 33(1)/(3)% marks in an exam and failed by 20 marks. If he had got 50%, he would have passed by 10 marks. Find total marks.
solution:
**Given:**

Marks obtained = 33 1/3%

Fail by = 20

Marks if 50% = pass by 10

**Formula Used:**

Difference in marks = Difference in percentage × Total marks

**Calculation:**

 Rightarrow 33(1)/(3)\% = (1)/(3) 

 Rightarrow 50\% = (1)/(2) 

 Rightarrow {Difference in marks} = 20 + 10 = 30 

 Rightarrow {Difference in %} = (1)/(2) - (1)/(3) 

 Rightarrow = (1)/(6) 

 Rightarrow (1)/(6) times {Total marks} = 30 

 Rightarrow {Total marks} = 30 times 6 

 Rightarrow = 180 

**∴ The correct answer is 180 **
